correctness.rationale: Exact rational function poles 1±i ensure well-defined Markov-generator evaluation. The Taylor coefficient of z^4 is -1/4, proving small-step negativity for every n>=5. Exact inverse-polynomial numerators prove unconditional positivity through n=4 and two distinct sharp n=5 quartic boundaries. Dominant spectral projector and transient Jordan asymptotics prove eventual positivity in each finite dimension. The standalone sympy checker passed 239 exact arithmetic identities, including numerator identities, row sums, and rational witnesses; finite checks do not substitute for the analytic dimension proof.

value.rationale: The result resolves the natural cone-positivity boundary for the actual second-order implicit multiderivative SSP method on two foundational Markov transports: nearest-neighbor cyclic circulation and acyclic absorbing transport. The exact n=5 barrier, two topology-dependent recovery roots and all-dimension eventual recovery expose an unexpected reentrant step-size phenomenon not captured by scalar stability or mass conservation. The distinction also tests where a conditional unconditional-SSP theorem can be applied without overstating it.
